basic_details.job_title: WB Police Driver Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 5 Posts

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

qualification.details: The applicant must be a citizen of India and should be a permanent resident of West Bengal.

salary_details.details: The consolidated remuneration will be subject to applicable statutory deductions as per Government norms.

selection_process: The selection process consists of shortlisting of valid applications followed by a Driving Test

and a Medical Examination. Shortlisted candidates possessing valid applications will be called for a Driving Test and Interview carrying 40 marks (Driving Test - 20 & Interview - 20). A merit list will be prepared based on the marks obtained. Provisionally selected candidates will then undergo a medical fitness test and verification of character and antecedents.
Shortlisted candidates will be called for a Driving Test and Interview. Full marks are 40
divided into 20 marks for the Driving Test and 20 marks for the Interview. A merit list will be published on the Howrah GRP website (https://howrahgrp.wb.gov.in/).
Provisionally selected candidates will have to undergo a medical fitness test as directed by the competent authority.
Selected candidates will be required to submit a Police Clearance Certificate or undergo verification as prescribed by the competent authority at the time of joining.
how_to_apply: Download the application format from the West Bengal Police Website (https://wbpolice.gov.in/) or Howrah GRP Website (https://howrahgrp.wb.gov.in/).
Print the application on white A4 size paper.
Fill up the application form in CAPITAL LETTERS.
Paste one recent passport-size photograph (4.5 cm x 3.5 cm) self-attested on the top right of the application.
Attach self-attested copies of Aadhaar Card, Voter ID Card, PAN Card, Driving License, Educational Qualification certificates, and Experience certificate.
Superscribe the envelope as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF DRIVER (CONTRACTUAL), 2026".

Submit the application personally in the DROP BOX or by Speed Post at the Office of the Superintendent of Railway Police, Howrah, 2nd Floor Yatri Niwas, New Complex, Howrah Rly Station, Howrah- 711101 on or before 21 October 2026.
important_instructions: The engagement will be purely temporary and contractual for a period of 01 (one) year. Renewal of the contract will be subject to satisfactory performance and approval of the competent authority. Contractual drivers shall not be absorbed in, or claim appointment to, the regular establishment of the Government. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates attending the Driving Test and Interview. Canvassing in any form and/or bringing any influence will be treated as disqualification. Incomplete applications without required documents will be rejected. All original documents will be verified at the time of Interview. The competent authority reserves the absolute right to cancel the recruitment/engagement process at any stage without prior notice.

Shortlisted candidates will be called for a Driving Test and Interview. Full marks are 40, divided into 20 marks for the Driving Test and 20 marks for the Interview. A merit list will be published on the Howrah GRP website (https://howrahgrp.wb.gov.in/). Provisionally selected candidates will have to undergo a medical fitness test as directed by the competent authority. Selected candidates will be required to submit a Police Clearance Certificate or undergo verification as prescribed by the competent authority at the time of joining.

faq.question: Q1. What is WB Police Driver Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: WB Police Driver Recruitment 2026 is an offline recruitment process conducted by the Office of the Superintendent of Railway Police, Howrah, for engaging 5 Temporary Drivers on a contractual basis for one year.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in WB Police Driver Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available for the Driver (Temporary / Contractual Basis) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for WB Police Driver Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 21 October 2026 within 14 days after publication in the website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for WB Police Driver?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Class VIII from a recognized school, possess a valid Four-Wheeler Driving Licence, and have at least 2 years of driving experience in a Government, Quasi Government, or Registered Private Limited company.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for WB Police Driver post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 40 years as on the date of advertisement (07.10.2026).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for WB Police Driver Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for WB Police Driver post?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application form from the official website, print it on white A4 paper, fill it out in CAPITAL LETTERS, attach self-attested documents and a photo, and submit it by speed post or drop box to the Office of the Superintendent of Railway Police, Howrah.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for WB Police Driver Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes the shortlisting of valid applications, a Driving Test and Interview carrying 40 marks, followed by a Medical Examination and character and antecedent verification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for WB Police Driver post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 16,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely temporary and contractual for a period of one year, and contractual drivers shall not be absorbed in or claim appointment to the regular establishment of the Government.
